NXP Semiconductors is seeking an AI/ML ASIC Design and Implementation Automation Intern to join its Advanced Chip Engineering organization. The intern will explore and develop methodology, flows, and tools that improve ASIC, SoC, and IP design efficiency and quality, while applying state-of-the-art computer-aided design and AI/ML automation techniques.

Responsibilities
As an "AI/ML ASIC Design and Implementation Automation Intern" in our Advanced Chip Engineering (ACE) organization, you will learn in a dynamic environment where we explore and innovate on methodology, flows, and tools to improve efficiency and quality of results (power, performance, area, and quality) for ASIC (Application Specific Integrated Circuits), SoC (System on Chip), and IP (Intellectual Property)
You'll be working and connecting with automation experts as well as academia to explore state-of-the-art Computer-Aided Design (CAD) techniques as part of VLSI CAD Software development
